immutable-protocol.description: Existing .pipeline paths, persisted pipeline_* keys, phase ids and historical ledger bytes remain readable protocol facts.

historical-evidence.description: Archived OpenSpec changes, approved ADR/research/plan evidence and Git history are not rewritten.

migration-only.description: The frozen old distribution channel may name the retired identity solely to migrate existing installations.

compatibility-fixture.description: N-1 and explicit legacy fixtures may retain exact historical bytes for compatibility verification.

forbidden-current-product.description: Current commands, manifests, launchers, package names, docs, Dashboard copy and generated release assets must expose only Tenon.
